8 ‘Wear Everyday’ Kind of Pieces at Target Right Now

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:36
Instaread

Hi friends! I popped into Target over the weekend to pick up a birthday gift, but instead I looked through the women’s section and found some cute things! Everything shown is under $50 (well under!) and for the best part everything fits true to size. If you like a few easy to wear, everyday pieces then have I got some picks for you!

I can’t believe these jeans are under $20! I picked up this darker hue, I think this one is the most versatile for winter. I am in the 10, perfect fit and plenty long! It is the most fitted at the waist / hips. They are high waist, but just FYI.

Find the jeans here.

(PS: Loved this mock neck sweater but it isn’t online yet! I’ll keep any eye on it but it is in store FYI.)

10 out of 10 on these pants! They are a stretchy ponte fabric (love) and they have a great fit. This is the medium but I’d probably size up to a large. The waist was just a touch snug. I also would go with the black! These pants would be unstoppable in a black ponte, they literally go with everything!

Find the pants here! 

Okay I didn’t believe it, so I checked out the under $50 cashmere myself. This sweater is legit! It’s the softest cashmere and the fit is perfect. The only thing I didn’t love on the cardigan are the buttons, they come across a little cheap but other than that, this is a great find! Super soft, non-itchy and feels luxe. Definitely gives J.Crew a run for their money. I am in the large, love this fit for me.

Find the cashmere sweater here. 

I gotta admit I didn’t think I’d love this jacket as much as I did! It’s a really cute fit, slightly boxy but the crop is a perfect length. It runs big, I would size down to the medium for me (I’m typically a large in coats / jacket). Honestly, 10 out of 10 for me. Quite warm, too. Such a fun look for a holiday coat.

Find the faux fur jacket here!

Absolutely recommend these pants! I’ve been low key collecting pants like these because I wear them all the time! They’re a nice break from a legging. This pair is so comfortable, there is a small drawstring at the elastic waist. I am in the medium, fit is fine but I’d probably go up a size so I can toss them in the dryer, ya know? Most fitted at waist. Comes in a few colors, too! Find the pants here. 

Now this is a spanx dupe if I’ve ever seen one! Love this tunic (I have it tucked under here.) Fit is great, I went with the large and it’s a nice loose fit. I’d say it’s an oversized fit over all. Under $40 and highly recommended! Find the tunic here. 

I don’t know what to call this kind of fabric but I love it. I feel like I’ve only found this fabric from JoyLab – it’s a stretchy, ribbed fabric, so comfortable and so stretchy. I snatched these up immediately. I bought the large, perfect fit (they are more fitted.) I also found the flare leg looked nice but not too overally flare. Super cute! Shop the flare leggings here. 

This jacket is a great find! It’s a lighter weight, slightly ribbed fabric. It runs quite big, this is the large and I’d size down to a medium for a better fit. (Unless you want a generous fit!) Super cute and is a nice departure from a hoodie or sweatshirt with leggings.

Find the zip jacket here. 

Shop the Outfit

Fit Details

I am 5’9″ and a size 8/10. I typically wear a medium or large most days.
